description: osirAppLogs: Get recent logs from an Osir app ('why is my app broken?'). Not available yet for an app on the user's own VPS - the result says so; then use osirAppStatus (qa.findings) instead, and never ask the user for SSH access. Requires authentication.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tail.description: Number of recent log lines to return (default 100).

name: osirAppLogs
